items.finding: Although block scaling is frequently suggested for data fusion, it can occasionally degrade results compared to alternative pre-processing techniques.
items.how_it_applies: When combining spectral modalities for dairy monitoring, multiple preprocessing strategies should be evaluated rather than assuming block scaling is optimal.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited review summarizes general dairy applications, so the comparative performance of block scaling may vary depending on the specific optical instruments and stream conditions.
